{"metadata":{"description":"Tool search & slimming for DeepSeek Harness: Hermes-style progressive disclosure — search, describe, and call long-tail tools on demand","id":"gh:1334016644","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-tool-search","slug":"Letter2025/dsh-tool-search","topics":["dsh-plugin","hermes","tool-search"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Tool search & slimming for DeepSeek Harness: Hermes-style progressive disclosure — search, describe,"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" and call long-tail tools on demand"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-tool-search"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Tool search & slimming for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): Hermes-style progressive disclosure. When your to"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ol catalog gets large (many MCP servers or plugin tools), every tool's JSON schema is injected into "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"the model context on every turn — wasting tokens on tools the task never uses. This plugin collapses"},{"id":"p3s4","text":" the long tail behind three bridge tools and lets the model discover and load them on demand through"},{"id":"p3s5","text":" a configured **rerank model**."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"- **Core tools stay eager** — file/shell/essential tools are always directly visible.
- **Bridge too"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ls** — `tool_search`, `tool_describe`, `tool_call` replace the deferred schemas.
- **Tiered disclosu"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"re** — the visible listing shrinks automatically as the catalog grows.
- **Conversational setup** — "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"the bundled `tool-slimmer-setup` skill groups your tools by talking to you, and guides configuring t"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"he rerank model.
- **User or project config** — groups/matcher live in `~/.dsh/dsh-tool-search.json`"},{"id":"p4s6","text":" (global) or `<workspace>/.dsh/dsh-tool-search.json` (per project), your choice."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Inspired by Hermes Agent's Tool Search. On every turn, the plugin's `system-prompt/assemble` listene"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"r computes the tier and replaces the model-visible tools:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Tier | Condition | Model sees |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| 0 | Small catalog / nothing deferrable | Every tool, bridge absent |
| 1 | Grouped manifest fits t"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"he budget | Bridge + `## group` name/description listing |
| 2 | Only names fit | Bridge + names-onl"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"y listing |
| 3 | Even names overflow | Bridge + one line per group (name: count) |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Budget = `min(thresholdPct% × contextWindow, listingMaxTokens)`, recomputed every turn. The manifest"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" rides a runtime context, so it survives complete-prompt composition."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Dynamic injection**: searching, describing, or calling a deferred tool warms it into the session's"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" visible set (LRU-bounded by `maxWarmTools`), so its full schema is injected into the context for la"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ter turns — the model pulls tools into context on demand instead of keeping everything."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"When `tool_call` runs, the plugin executes the **real tool by name** through `ctx.tools.execute`, so"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" approvals, guards, and session events all reference the underlying tool — never the bridge. `tool_s"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"earch` ranks with the configured rerank matcher and falls back to keyword matching (exact name > nam"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"e tokens > description tokens) when no matcher is configured or the rerank call fails."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Setup (conversational)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Ask your agent:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> 帮我配置 dsh-tool-search 的工具分组"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The `tool-slimmer-setup` skill will read the catalog, propose groups, confirm with you, ask whether "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"the config should be **global or per-project**, and guide you through configuring the rerank matcher"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" (required for `tool_search` and preload)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Static tuning lives in your profile `cordis.patch.yml` (restart to change):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Tool groups, the matcher, and preload live in the runtime file (`~/.dsh/dsh-tool-search.json` for us"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"s, the matcher, and preload live in the runtime file (`~/.dsh/dsh-tool-search.json` for user scope):"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- `groups`: exact tool names and/or name prefixes; a tool belongs to the first matching group.
- `ma"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"tcher`: an OpenAI-compatible `/v1/rerank` endpoint — the only matcher type. `tool_search` returns se"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"tup guidance until one is configured.
- `preload`: optional; when enabled (with a matcher), the sess"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ion's first turn semantically preloads the top-K matching tools into the eager set.
- The file is wa"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"tched by mtime and hot-reloads; changes take effect on the next turn."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Bridge tools"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| `tool_search(query, limit?)` | Search the deferred catalog (rerank, keyword fallback) and return r"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"anked `{name, description, group}` matches; matches are injected into the visible context |
| `tool_"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"describe(name)` | Load the full schema of one deferred tool; the tool is injected into the visible c"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ontext |
| `tool_call(name, arguments)` | Invoke a deferred tool by real name; approvals/guards/even"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"ts use the real tool; the tool is injected into the visible context |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Design notes & pitfalls"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- Slimming only rewrites the **model-visible surface** (`system-prompt/assemble`); the registry stay"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"s complete, so deferred tools remain executable.
- The bridge, the two setup tools, and `skill` are "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"always eager and never defer themselves.
- **PTC (`run_code`) scopes keep the transport, not the dec"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"larations.** Such a scope's wire table is collapsed to `run_code` alone, with every declaration move"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"d into the `tools:sdk` prompt section — the tokens this plugin exists to slim. The plugin leaves tha"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"t table alone (replacing it deleted `run_code` from the prompt) and re-renders the section instead: "},{"id":"p28s7","text":"the eager core plus the bridge tools, with the deferred catalog injected as a runtime context under "},{"id":"p28s8","text":"a `run_code`-aware header. The section's generator is read from its own text (`interface ToolArgsMap"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"` = TypeScript, `TypedDict` = Python); text from an unknown generator is left untouched rather than "},{"id":"p28s10","text":"rewritten in the wrong language. A `both` scope keeps `run_code` eager (the bridge refuses to invoke"},{"id":"p28s11","text":" it by name) and gets the same declaration rewrite; native sessions are unaffected.
